article_content: A newly identified predator, known as the 'coywolf', is a unique hybrid resulting from the mating of wolves and Eastern coyotes. This creature, discovered in regions like West Virginia and north of the Great Lakes, owes its existence to human activities that brought different species closer together. The coywolf possesses a distinctive genetic makeup, comprising approximately 1/4 wolf DNA, 2/3 coyote DNA, and the remainder from domesticated dogs. This new breed emerged over the past decade as wolves, driven north by hunting, encountered coyotes moving east from the Great Plains. Genetically, grey wolves and coyotes are closely related but diverged evolutionarily millions of years ago. The coywolf, however, combines the strengths of both species. It is up to 40% larger than the Western coyote, with powerful wolf-like jaws and a more social nature that enables pack hunting. This hybridization allows coywolves to hunt larger prey and adapt better to urban environments. Scientists have conducted studies to understand this new breed better. Laboratory experiments involved creating 50/50 hybrids by mating female coyotes with grey wolves. Although there were initial setbacks with failed pregnancies, one successful litter of six puppies was born. These hybrids demonstrated superior adaptability, particularly in times of scarcity, by foraging effectively. Overall, coywolves tend to thrive more than their non-hybrid parent species. The emergence of coywolves underscores how human activities and climate change can break down barriers between species, leading to interbreeding. The rapid warming of the Arctic, which is occurring at two to four times the global rate, is forcing animals to adapt and move, thereby increasing the likelihood of such interbreeding.

article_content: A significant Defense Department contractor, KBR, has directed its staff in Iraq to hand over their personal cell phones, citing 'a safety and security concern.' The company, based in Houston, Texas, has warned that anyone caught using a personal cell phone will face disciplinary measures, which could include termination. KBR, previously known as Kellogg Brown & Root, released a statement confirming the order but did not elaborate on the specific security issue. 'The matter giving rise to this message is still being reviewed by KBR management, so the company will not provide further comment at this time,' the statement read. According to an internal email acquired by CNN, the directive was issued to all KBR employees in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Kuwait, although KBR's public communications only mentioned Iraq. The email instructs employees to cease using their cell phones by 8 a.m. Saturday and to surrender them to the company's human resources department. 'Any individual using a personal cell phone will be disciplined,' the email states. 'Termination is an option of discipline. The cell phone will be confiscated.' Employees will receive a receipt upon turning in their phones, which will be returned when they leave the site. Haris Memisevic, KBR's quality manager in Afghanistan, who forwarded the email to some employees, declined to comment and referred inquiries to KBR's legal department. An anonymous KBR employee expressed that they were unaware of any security breaches involving cell phones and had not been given a reason for the order. They also mentioned that they do not plan to comply, believing their personal safety would be jeopardized without a cell phone. 'KBR has a communication system, but as with any system, it does fail, and we can only communicate with another installation by using cell phones,' they said. 'We pay for this use with our own funds.' Some corporate employees have company-provided cell phones, but at certain locations, there is only one company-provided phone for use if the communication system fails. The employee noted that the U.S. Army confiscates cell phones from Afghans working at military installations and returns them after their daily duties are completed. An Army spokesperson confirmed to CNN that the order is solely a KBR initiative.

Virksomheden, der har hovedkvarter i Houston, Texas, har advaret om, at enhver, der bliver fanget i brug af en personlig mobiltelefon, vil blive udsat for disciplinære foranstaltninger, herunder fyring. KBR, tidligere kendt som Kellogg Brown & Root, udsendte en erklæring, der bekræftede ordren, men gik ikke i detaljer med det specifikke sikkerhedsspørgsmål. 'Sagen, der giver anledning til denne besked, bliver fortsat gennemgået af KBR's ledelse, så virksomheden vil ikke give yderligere kommentarer på nuværende tidspunkt,' lød det i erklæringen. Ifølge en intern e-mail, som CNN har fået fat i, blev direktivet udstedt til alle KBR-medarbejdere i Irak, Afghanistan og Kuwait, selvom KBR's offentlige kommunikation kun nævnte Irak. E-mailen instruerer medarbejderne om at stoppe med at bruge deres mobiltelefoner kl. 8 om lørdag morgen og aflevere dem til virksomhedens HR-afdeling. 'Enhver, der bruger en personlig mobiltelefon, vil blive disciplineret,' står der i e-mailen. 'Opsigelse er et disciplinmulighed. Mobiltelefonen vil blive konfiskeret.' Haris Memisevic, KBR's kvalitetschef i Afghanistan, der videresendte e-mailen til nogle medarbejdere, afslog at kommentere og henviste henvendelser til KBR's juridiske afdeling. En anonym KBR-medarbejder udtrykte, at de ikke var klar over nogen sikkerhedsbrud, der involverede mobiltelefoner, og ikke var givet en årsag til ordren. De nævnte også, at de ikke planlægger at overholde, da de mener, at deres personlige sikkerhed ville være i fare uden en mobiltelefon. 'KBR har et kommunikationssystem, men som med ethvert system svigter det, og vi kan kun kommunikere med en anden installation ved hjælp af mobiltelefoner,' sagde de. 'Vi betaler for denne brug med vores egne midler.' Nogle virksomhedsmedarbejdere har firmaudstyrsmobiltelefoner, men på visse steder er der kun én firmaudstyrstelefon til brug, hvis kommunikationssystemet svigter. Medarbejderen bemærkede, at den amerikanske hær konfiskerer mobiltelefoner fra afghanere, der arbejder på militære installationer, og returnerer dem, når deres daglige opgaver er fuldført. En talsmand for hæren bekræftede over for CNN, at ordren udelukkende er et KBR-initiativ.

article_content: A passenger was detained after he activated the emergency exit on a plane in an attempt to leave faster. Just after China Eastern flight MU2331 from Xi’an landed at Sanya Fenghaung International Airport in Hainan, the impatient traveler tried to find a quicker way out. By triggering the emergency exit, he deployed the emergency slide, leading to an almost two-hour delay. Airport personnel managed to deflate the slide, but their efforts resulted in a significant delay. The man was arrested for his actions. When questioned about his motives, he stated that he wanted to exit the plane faster and claimed he hadn't paid attention to the in-flight safety instructions. The flight attendants attempted to prevent the slide from deploying but were unsuccessful. The cost of the man's actions is estimated to be around £10,000. This incident follows another recent event where a Chinese woman scalded a flight attendant with hot noodles after learning she wouldn't be seated next to her boyfriend. That incident occurred on a charter flight from Bangkok to Nanjing, with passengers capturing the drama on their smartphones. During the chaos, a man believed to be the woman's boyfriend threatened to blow up the plane. However, he later claimed the scalding was an accident during a dispute over a receipt for hot water.

article_content: President Biden gazes at a large 'Welcome to Mexico' sign hanging over the Bridge of the Americas during his tour of the port of entry in El Paso, Texas, on Jan. 8. Andrew Harnik/AP SAN DIEGO — For the first time on record, Venezuelans have become the largest nationality arrested for illegally crossing the U.S. border, surpassing Mexicans. According to figures released Saturday, September saw the second-highest month for arrests of all nationalities. The Border Patrol arrested Venezuelans 54,833 times in September after they entered from Mexico, more than double the 22,090 arrests in August and exceeding the previous monthly high of 33,749 in September 2022. Overall, arrests of all nationalities entering from Mexico totaled 218,763 in September, up 21% from 181,084 in August and nearing the all-time high of 222,018 in December 2022, according to U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Arrests for the government's budget year ending Sept. 30 topped 2 million for the second consecutive year, down 7% from an all-time high of over 2.2 million arrests the previous year. Venezuela's political, economic, and humanitarian crisis over the past decade has driven more than 7 million people to leave the country. Initially settling in nearby Latin American countries, many have migrated to the United States in the last three years, establishing themselves in cities like New York and Chicago. The Biden administration recently granted temporary legal status to nearly 500,000 Venezuelans who were in the U.S. by July 31, while pledging to deport those who arrive illegally afterward and fail to secure asylum. Deportation flights to Venezuela have begun as part of a diplomatic thaw with Nicolás Maduro's government. Troy Miller, acting commissioner of Customs and Border Protection, stated, 'We are continually engaging with domestic and foreign partners to address historic hemispheric migration, including large migrant groups traveling on freight trains, and to enforce consequences including direct repatriations to Venezuela.' For decades, Mexicans comprised the majority of illegal border crossings, but this has shifted to include more Central Americans and, recently, individuals from South America, Africa, and Asia. In September, Mexicans were arrested 39,733 times, trailing Venezuelans. Republicans have seized on the latest numbers, with leading presidential candidates framing the border as a major issue for next year's elections. Rep. Mark Green of Tennessee, chair of the House Homeland Security Committee, criticized the policies of Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas. The Biden administration proposed about $14 billion for border security in a $106 billion spending package announced Friday, insisting that a long-term solution requires congressional support. The administration has adopted a carrot-and-stick approach, offering new legal pathways for asylum seekers while imposing restrictions on those who do not comply. Approximately 43,000 migrants used the CBP One app to enter the U.S. at land crossings with Mexico in September, bringing the total to nearly 278,000 since the online appointment system began in January. Additionally, over 265,000 people from Cuba, Haiti, Nicaragua, and Venezuela entered through airports after applying online with financial sponsors. Including these legal pathways, the number of crossings reached a new all-time monthly high of 269,735 in September and a new budget-year high of nearly 2.5 million.

Andrew Harnik/AP SAN DIEGO — For første gang nogensinde er venezuelanere blevet den største nationalitet, der er anholdt for ulovligt at krydse den amerikanske grænse, og har dermed overhalet mexicanere. Ifølge tal offentliggjort lørdag var september den næsthøjeste måned for anholdelser af alle nationaliteter. Grænsepatruljen anholdt venezuelanere 54.833 gange i september efter de kom ind fra Mexico, mere end det dobbelte af de 22.090 anholdelser i august og overstigende den tidligere månedlige rekord på 33.749 i september 2022. I alt blev der anholdt 218.763 personer af alle nationaliteter, der kom ind fra Mexico i september, en stigning på 21% fra 181.084 i august og tæt på det hidtil højeste antal på 222.018 i december 2022, ifølge U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Anholdelserne for regeringens budgetår, der sluttede den 30. september, nåede 2 millioner for andet år i træk, en nedgang på 7% fra det hidtil højeste antal på over 2,2 millioner anholdelser året før. Venezuelas politiske, økonomiske og humanitære krise i de seneste ti år har tvunget over 7 millioner mennesker til at forlade landet. Oprindeligt bosatte de sig i nabolande i Latinamerika, men mange er flyttet til USA i de sidste tre år og har slået sig ned i byer som New York og Chicago. Biden-administrationen gav nyligt midlertidig lovlig status til næsten 500.000 venezuelanere, der var i USA den 31. juli, mens de lovede at udvise dem, der kommer ulovligt herefter og ikke får asyl. Deportationsflyvninger til Venezuela er begyndt som en del af en diplomatisk tøbrud med Nicolás Maduros regering. Troy Miller, fungerende kommissær for Customs and Border Protection, udtalte: 'Vi samarbejder kontinuerligt med indenlandske og udenlandske partnere for at håndtere historisk migrationsbevægelse i voz hemisfære, herunder store migrantgrupper, der rejser med godstog, og for at håndhæve konsekvenser, herunder direkte hjemsendelser til Venezuela.' I årtier udgjorde mexicanere flertallet af ulovlige grænseovergange, men dette har skiftet til at omfatte flere centralamerikanere og nylig personer fra Sydamerika, Afrika og Asien. I september blev mexicanere anholdt 39.733 gange, efter venezuelanerne. Republikanerne har taget fat i de nyeste tal, mens førende præsidentkandidater rammer grænsen ind som et stort valgtema til næste års valg. Repræsentant Mark Green fra Tennessee, formand for House Homeland Security Committee, kritiserede politikken til Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas. Biden-administrationen foreslog omkring 14 milliarder dollars til grænsesikkerhed i et udgiftsforslag på 106 milliarder dollars, der blev offentliggjort fredag, og insisterede på, at en langsigtet løsning kræver støtte fra Kongressen. Administrationen har taget en gulerod-og-pisk-tilgang ved at tilbyde nye lovlige veje for asylansøgere, mens den pålægger restriktioner på dem, der ikke overholder dem. Omkring 43.000 migranter brugte CBP One-appen til at komme ind i USA ved grænseovergange med Mexico i september, hvilket bringer det samlede antal op på næsten 278.000 siden det online aftalesystem startede i januar. Desuden kom over 265.000 personer fra Cuba, Haiti, Nicaragua og Venezuela ind via lufthavne efter at have ansøgt online med økonomiske sponsorer. Med disse lovlige veje nåede antallet af overgange et nyt månedligt højdepunkt på 269.735 i september og et nyt budgetårshøjdepunkt på næsten 2,5 millioner.

article_content: By Ryan Lipman and Sarah Michael  After taking two bites of his McChicken burger, Adelaide resident James Parsons knew something was seriously wrong. Mr. Parsons, 26, runs a pool maintenance business and was between jobs on Monday when he ordered the burger for lunch from the Reynella McDonald's drive-thru, south of Adelaide CBD, around 1 pm.  'He took the first bite and thought, this isn't warm,' his wife Philippa told Daily Mail Australia. 'He was starving and on the go—he took the second bite and looked down to find the whole patty was raw.'  The couple lives in Hallett Cove, south of Adelaide CBD, and Mrs. Parsons, 26, said her husband was grossed out by what he believed was raw chicken. 'It's put us both off... I doubt he'll eat McDonald's again,' she said. 'I can't say I'll never eat it again, but I definitely won't for a while.'  Mr. Parsons immediately pulled over his car and called the McDonald's restaurant to report his discovery. 'They told him to bring the burger back and they would replace it, but he said, That's not good enough,' she said.  After contacting the store, Mr. Parsons was told he could get a replacement if he returned the burger. At this point, Mr. Parsons called his wife, who was not with him, to tell her what had happened. 'I said we need to do something about this—we need to make people aware. I'm 30 weeks pregnant and if that happened to me it could have killed the baby,' she said.  Mrs. Parsons then called the South Australia McDonald's head office to alert them about the incident. After explaining that the store offered to replace the burger, Mrs. Parsons reiterated that this was not good enough. She was asked if the couple still had the burger and if so, to take photos and send them to the company.  Once Mr. Parsons came home and gave the burger to his wife, Mrs. Parsons took some images and sent them in an email. She was told the incident would be investigated and someone would get back to her.  Despite eating some of the meat in the burger, Mr. Parsons has not fallen ill from consuming what he believes was raw chicken.  Mrs. Parsons said she was surprised her husband had not been seriously ill from eating what he believes was raw chicken. 'He hasn't at all been sick, which is lucky—he's grown up in the country and has quite a strong stomach,' she said. 'I actually nearly rang the hospital to see whether there was something he could take to prevent food poisoning—we weren't sure what to do about eating raw chicken.'  On Wednesday, a spokesman for McDonald's told Daily Mail Australia: 'We are disappointed that this has happened. We take food safety very seriously and have strict processes and systems in place. We are currently investigating this with the restaurant and liaising with the customer directly.'  As of Tuesday night, Mrs. Parsons had yet to hear anything more from McDonald's, despite sending a follow-up email earlier in the day. 'I sent an email to the same guy asking what was going on and if there was any report, and I haven't received an email back,' she said.  Mrs. Parsons said she was outraged at how what she believes was a raw patty could have made it into the burger. 'I think we should be getting some kind of compensation—I don't know what, but it's so dangerous, there's no excuse,' she said. 'It's such a big franchise, I would think it would be so well monitored.'  After Mrs. Parsons took the photos of the burger, she posted the images on her personal Facebook page. 'People were disgusted and they shared the photo,' she said.  Mrs. Parsons said the burger is currently in her freezer.
translated_content: Af Ryan Lipman og Sarah Michael  Efter at have taget to bidder af sin McChicken-burger, vidste Adelaide-indbyggeren James Parsons, at der var noget alvorligt galt. Hr. Parsons, 26, driver en poolvedligeholdelsesvirksomhed og var mellem jobs mandag, da han bestilte burgeren til frokost fra Reynella McDonald's køre-gennem, syd for Adelaide CBD, omkring kl. 13.  'Han tog det første bid og tænkte, det er ikke varmt', fortalte hans kone Philippa Daily Mail Australia. 'Han var sulten og på farten – han tog det andet bid og kiggede ned for at finde, at hele bøffen var rå.'  Parret bor i Hallett Cove, syd for Adelaide CBD, og fru Parsons, 26, sagde, at hendes mand blev kvalmet af, hvad han troede var rå kylling. 'Det har sat os begge af – jeg tvivler på, at han vil spise McDonald's igen', sagde hun. 'Jeg kan ikke sige, at jeg aldrig vil spise det igen, men jeg vil sikkert ikke i en stund.'  Hr. Parsons trak straks bilen til side og ringede til McDonald's-restauranten for at rapportere sin opdagelse. 'De sagde til ham, at han skulle bringe burgeren tilbage, så de kunne erstatte den, men han sagde: Det er ikke godt nok', sagde hun.  Efter at have kontaktet butikken blev hr. Parsons fortalt, at han kunne få en erstatning, hvis han returnerede burgeren. På dette tidspunkt ringede hr. Parsons til sin kone, som ikke var sammen med ham, for at fortælle hende, hvad der var sket. 'Jeg sagde, vi skal gøre noget ved det – vi skal gøre folk opmærksomme. Jeg er 30 uger gravid, og hvis det var sket for mig, kunne det have dræbt babyen', sagde hun.  Fru Parsons ringede derefter til McDonald's hovedkontor i South Australia for at advare dem om hændelsen. Efter at have forklaret, at butikken tilbød at erstatte burgeren, gentog fru Parsons, at dette ikke var godt nok. Hun blev bedt om, hvis parret stadig havde burgeren, at tage billeder og sende dem til virksomheden.  Da hr. Parsons kom hjem og gav burgeren til sin kone, tog fru Parsons nogle billeder og sendte dem i en e-mail. Hendes blev fortalt, at hændelsen ville blive undersøgt, og at nogen ville komme tilbage til hende.  Selvom han spiste noget af kødet i burgeren, er hr. Parsons ikke blevet syg af at spise, hvad han tror var rå kylling.  Fru Parsons sagde, at hun var forbavset over, at hendes mand ikke var blevet alvorligt syg af at spise, hvad han tror var rå kylling. 'Han er slet ikke blevet syg, hvilket er heldigt – han er vokset op på landet og har en temmelig jernmave', sagde hun. 'Jeg nærmede faktisk at ringe til hospitalet for at se, om der var noget, han kunne tage for at forebygge fødevarelære – vi var ikke sikre på, hvad vi skulle gøre ved at spise rå kylling.'  Onsdag fortalte en talsmand for McDonald's Daily Mail Australia: 'Vi er skuffede over, at dette er sket. Vi tager fødevaresikkerhed meget alvorligt og har strenge processer og systemer på plads. Vi undersøger i øjeblikket dette med restauranten og er i dialog med kunden direkte.'  Pr. tirsdag aften havde fru Parsons endnu ikke hørt mere fra McDonald's, selvom hun tidligere på dagen havde sendt en opfølgende e-mail. 'Jeg sendte en e-mail til den samme fyr og spurgte, hvad der foregik, og om der var nogen rapport, og jeg har ikke modtaget en e-mail tilbage', sagde hun.  Fru Parsons sagde, at hun var oprørt over, hvordan hvad hun tror var en rå patty, kunne have kommet i burgeren. 'Jeg synes, vi burde få en eller anden form for kompensation – jeg ved ikke hvad, men det er så farligt, der er ingen undskyldning', sagde hun. 'Det er så en stor franchise, jeg ville tro, at det ville blive så vel overvåget.'  Efter at fru Parsons havde taget billeder af burgeren, placerede hun billederne på sin personlige Facebook-side. 'Folk var kvalmet, og de delte billedet', sagde hun.  Fru Parsons sagde, at burgeren i øjeblikket er i hendes fryser.

article_content: The French comedian at the center of the controversy over the 'quenelle' gesture has been banned from entering Britain, UK authorities said Monday. Dieudonne M'bala M'bala has been widely associated with the gesture -- which involves pointing the right arm straight down and touching that arm with the left hand -- that many believe is a Nazi salute in reverse. Dieudonne counters that it is anti-establishment but not anti-Semitic. 'We can confirm that Mr. Dieudonne is subject to an exclusion order,' Britain's Home Office said. 'The Home Secretary will seek to exclude an individual from the UK if she considers that there are public policy or public security reasons to do so.' The comedian has voiced his support for controversial French soccer star Nicolas Anelka, who faces a possible five-match suspension after being charged by the English Football Association for making a 'quenelle' gesture in December. The 34-year-old striker made the sign after scoring for his Premier League team, West Bromwich Albion, against West Ham on December 28. Anelka has insisted that the gesture was a dedication to his friend Dieudonne. The 46-year-old Dieudonne, who ran in the European elections as an anti-Zionist, has been fined several times in France for anti-Semitic commentary. The French government said last month that it wanted to ban his live performances.

article_content: While foreign institutional investors, also known as the big bulls of Dalal Street, remain the primary driving force, the enormous amount of money poured in by domestic investors in the last couple of years has helped in cushioning the downside. Even as global inflation and growth risks prompt FIIs to pull money out of India, the faith in the country’s growth story has led domestic institutional and retail investors to invest heavily. 'Given that our domestic economy is growing at a decent rate, the investor community currently believes that every market decline is a buying opportunity and is, thus, investing heavily,' says Siddharth Oberoi, fund manager at Prudent Equity. If markets are offering growth and reasonable valuations, Oberoi sees inflows from both FIIs and domestic investors continuing. Edited excerpts from an interview with ETMarkets: How comfortable are you from a valuation perspective in the midcap and smallcap space? Is it time to switch to largecaps? Over the last six months, valuations have caught up with most mid and small cap stocks. For some, valuations have wildly exceeded their true worth. However, there is a large section within this group that still remains inexpensive. In investing, we are market cap agnostic. We invest in a stock where we analyze that the risk-reward is in our favor. We are finding value across market caps. Prudent Equity Ace fund has managed to give index-beating returns consistently. What are your top holdings and do you expect the outperformance to continue? Our returns are a testament to our investment philosophy which focuses on three key things: 1) not overpaying for growth, 2) buying at a discount to the intrinsic value, and 3) focusing on position sizing. This strategy has been proven time and again for us. As of date, the fund is delivering a return of 48% for the calendar year. We are beating our benchmark index by a wide margin of 41%. Our top holdings constitute Time Technoplast, Welspun Enterprises, and Ramky Infrastructure. Ramky has been a recent addition with a large allocation. The company underwent a one-time settlement (OTS) with banks which will result in the company substantially reducing its debt. Ramky has an order book of Rs 5,300 crore (non-O&M) to be executed in the next two years. Besides, the company generates Rs 400-500 crore annually from maintenance income. This should ensure that revenue and profit grow at 25-30% per annum for each of the next two years. As India’s growth story remains positive amid the global mayhem, do you see thematic strategies gaining traction? The focus should be on areas where growth visibility comfort exists for the next 12-24 months. We have positioned the portfolio accordingly. We are overweight in infrastructure and construction, real estate, and a few debt restructuring plays. Do you see domestic institutional inflows outpacing FII flows in the near to medium term? We have seen over the last three years the enormous amount of money that Indian investors have poured into the markets, ensuring that the continuous selling by FIIs is absorbed. Given that our domestic economy is growing at a decent rate, the investor community currently believes that every market decline is a buying opportunity and is, thus, investing heavily. However, as the saying goes, 'if there is value, buyers will find you in the middle of the ocean, in the dead of the night.' Hence, if the markets have growth and reasonable valuations to offer, both FIIs and domestic inflows will continue. Amidst the current domestic and global situation, what kind of asset allocation will help investors balance risk and returns? Most of the time, a long-term investor should be overweight in equities. Before allocating funds, investors should consider the next 12 to 24 months at the very least. In the run-up to the general elections, which sectors/themes are likely to play out in the domestic market? India is going through a major transformation and the government has made infrastructure a top priority. Roads and highways, tunnels, smart meters, defense, railway, and solar space are some of the themes that are likely to play out in the future. translated_content: Mens udenlandske institutionelle investorer, også kendt som de store tyre på Dalal Street, fortsat er den primære drivkraft, har den enorme mængde penge, der er pumpet ind af indenlandske investorer i de sidste par år, hjulpet med at dæmpe nedturen. Selvom globale inflation og vækstrisici får FIIs til at trække penge ud af Indien, har tilliden til landets væksthistorie ført til, at indenlandske institutionelle og detailinvestorer investerer tungt. 'Givet at vores indenlandske økonomi vokser med en anstændig hastighed, mener investerersamfundet i øjeblikket, at hvert markedsfald er en købsmulighed og investerer derfor tungt,' siger Siddharth Oberoi, fondsforvalter hos Prudent Equity. Hvis markederne tilbyder vækst og rimelige vurderinger, ser Oberoi tilstrømninger fra både FIIs og indenlandske investorer fortsætte. Redigerede uddrag fra et interview med ETMarkets: Hvor komfortabel er du fra en vurderingssynsvinkel i midcap- og smallcap-rummet? Er det tid til at skifte til largecaps? I løbet af de sidste seks måneder har vurderingerne indhentet de fleste mid- og smallcap-aktier. For nogle har vurderingerne langt overskredet deres sande værdi. Der er dog en stor gruppe inden for denne gruppe, der fortsat er billig. Når vi investerer, er vi markedsværdi-agnostiske. Vi investerer i en aktie, hvor vi analyserer, at risiko-afkast er til vores fordel. Vi finder værdi på tværs af markedsværdier. Prudent Equity Ace-fonden har formået at give indeks-slående afkast konsekvent. Hvad er dine topinvesteringer, og forventer du, at overpræstationen vil fortsætte? Vores afkast er et vidnesbyrd om vores investeringsfilosofi, der fokuserer på tre nøgleting: 1) ikke at overbetale for vækst, 2) at købe til en rabat på den indre værdi og 3) at fokusere på positionsstørrelse. Denne strategi har vist sig gennem tiderne for os. Pr. dags dato giver fonden et afkast på 48% for kalenderåret. Vi slår vores benchmarkindeks med en bred margin på 41%. Vores topinvesteringer udgør Time Technoplast, Welspun Enterprises og Ramky Infrastructure. Ramky har været en ny tilføjelse med en stor allokering. Virksomheden gennemgik en engangsafgørelse (OTS) med bankerne, hvilket vil resultere i, at virksomheden betydeligt reducerer sin gæld. Ramky har en ordbog på Rs 5.300 crore (ikke-O&M), der skal udføres i de næste to år. Foruden det genererer virksomheden Rs 400-500 crore årligt fra vedligeholdelsesindtægter. Dette bør sikre, at omsætning og overskud vokser med 25-30% om året i hvert af de næste to år. Mens Indiens væksthistorie forbliver positiv i den globale kaos, ser du tematiske strategier tage fart? Fokus bør være på områder, hvor der er komfortabel vækstsynlighed for de næste 12-24 måneder. Vi har positioneret porteføljen efter dette. Vi er overvægtede i infrastruktur og byggeri, ejendomme og nogle gældsomstruktureringsspil. Ser du indenlandske institutionelle tilstrømninger overgå FII-strømme i den nære til mellemste fremtid? Vi har set i løbet af de sidste tre år den enorme mængde penge, som indiske investorer har pumpet ind på markederne, hvilket sikrer, at den kontinuerlige salg af FIIs absorberes. Givet at vores indenlandske økonomi vokser med en anstændig hastighed, mener investerersamfundet i øjeblikket, at hvert markedsfald er en købsmulighed og investerer derfor tungt. Men som det gamle ordsprog siger, 'hvis der er værdi, vil køberne finde dig midt på havet, midt om natten.' Derfor, hvis markederne kan tilbyde vækst og rimelige vurderinger, vil både FIIs og indenlandske tilstrømninger fortsætte. Midt i den nuværende indenlandske og globale situation, hvilken slags aktieallokering vil hjælpe investorer med at balancere risiko og afkast? De fleste gange bør en langsigtet investor være overvægtede i aktier. Før tildeling af midler bør investorer overveje de næste 12 til 24 måneder mindst. I opkørslen til valget, hvilke sektorer/temaer er sandsynlige at spille ud på det indenlandske marked? Indien gennemgår en stor transformation, og regeringen har gjort infrastruktur til en top prioritet. Veje og motorveje, tunneler, intelligente målere, forsvar, jernbane og solenergi er nogle af temaerne, der sandsynligvis vil spille ud i fremtiden. article_content: Did business disputes contribute to the dramatic downfall of Kim Jong Un's once influential uncle? According to South Korea's main intelligence agency, this might be the case. The agency's suggestions were relayed by a lawmaker on Monday. Jang Song Thaek, Kim's uncle, played a crucial role in Kim's rise to power two years prior. However, in a sudden turn of events, Kim ordered Jang's execution earlier this month on charges of attempting to overthrow the government. The announcement of Jang's death was unusually public for the typically secretive North Korean regime. Analysts have proposed various reasons for Kim's decision to execute his uncle and publicize the event. Some speculate there was a power struggle between the two. Determining the exact motives may be impossible given North Korea's reclusive nature. Despite the challenges, South Korea's National Intelligence Service (NIS), which first reported Jang's fall from grace, is investigating the situation. On Monday, the agency briefed lawmakers from a parliamentary intelligence committee on their findings. Nam Jae-joon, the head of NIS, downplayed the theory of a simple power struggle. According to lawmaker Jeong Chung-rae, who attended the briefing, the NIS believes that Jang's aides in certain government agencies overstepped their authority in business projects, leading to conflicts with other agencies. The NIS suggests that Kim intervened and demanded resolution of these disputes, an order Jang allegedly refused to follow. This defiance may have sealed Jang's fate. North Korean state media hinted at business wrongdoings by Jang, stating that his group controlled key economic sectors, preventing proper oversight. They accused Jang of selling precious national resources at low prices. Analysts note that Jang, who had ties with Chinese officials, was more open to capitalist economic reforms than hardline regime members. By dismissing the idea of a direct power struggle, the NIS indicates that Kim's leadership remains stable. The regime continues to investigate agencies formerly under Jang's control. The NIS also believes that the images showing Jang being removed from a meeting were staged to demonstrate Kim's authority.
translated_content: Spillede erhvervskonflikter en rolle i den dramatiske fald af Kim Jong Un's engang indflydelsesrige onkel? Ifølge Sydkoreas hovedefterretningstjeneste kan dette være tilfældet. Tjenestens antydninger blev videregivet af en politiker mandag. Jang Song Thaek, Kim's onkel, spillede en afgørende rolle i Kim's magtovertagelse to år tidligere. Men i et pludseligt vendepunkt beordrede Kim Jang's henrettelse tidligere denne måned med anklager om at forsøge at vælte regeringen. Meddelelsen om Jang's død var usædvanligt offentlig for det normalt hemmelighedsfulde nordkoreanske regime. Analytikere har foreslået forskellige årsager til Kim's beslutning om at henrette sin onkel og offentliggøre begivenheden. Nogle spekulerer i, at der var en magtkamp mellem de to. At fastslå de præcise motiver kan være umuligt givet Nordkoreas lukkede natur. Trods udfordringerne undersøger Sydkoreas National Efterretningstjeneste (NIS), der først rapporterede om Jang's fald fra nåden, situationen. Mandag orienterede tjenesten politikere fra et parlamentarisk efterretningsudvalg om deres fund. Nam Jae-joon, chefen for NIS, nedtonede teorien om en simpel magtkamp. Ifølge politikeren Jeong Chung-rae, der deltog i orienteringen, mener NIS, at Jang's medhjælpere i visse regeringsorganer overskred deres myndighed i forretningsprojekter, hvilket førte til konflikter med andre organer. NIS foreslår, at Kim greb ind og krævede, at disse konflikter skulle løses, en ordre som Jang angiveligt nægtede at følge. Denne ulydighed kan have beseglet Jang's skæbne. Nordkoreansk statslig medier antydede erhvervsmæssige uregelmæssigheder fra Jang og hævdede, at hans gruppe kontrollerede nøgleøkonomiske sektorer, hvilket forhindrede korrekt tilsyn. De beskyldte Jang for at sælge værdifulde nationale ressourcer til lave priser. Analytikere bemærker, at Jang, der havde forbindelser til kinesiske embedsmænd, var mere åben over for kapitalistiske økonomiske reformer end hardlinere i regimet. Ved at afvise ideen om en direkte magtkamp, indikerer NIS, at Kim's lederskab forbliver stabilt. Regimet fortsætter med at undersøge organer, der tidligere var under Jang's kontrol. NIS mener også, at billederne, der viser Jang blive fjernet fra et møde, var iscenesat for at demonstrere Kim's autoritet.
